description: Content-addressable schema cache: deduplication by SHA-256 of canonical JSON. Implementations must return the same cached model for schemas with identical content regardless of load path or key order. PROTOCOL_SPEC §4.15.

test_cases.description: Two schema objects with identical content loaded from different paths must produce the same content hash and share one cached model object
Two schemas with different content must produce different hashes — cache must not merge distinct schemas
The same schema with object keys in different order must produce the same hash after canonical JSON normalization (sort_keys=True)
Schema is hashed after $ref resolution — the resolved (inlined) form is used for hashing, not the pre-resolution form containing $ref
The empty schema {} has a deterministic and stable hash — canonical form of {} is always the same across implementations
